name: ai-cover-letter-generator-workspace
description: Fullstack AI Cover Letter Generator built with React (Vite) and Express

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('node', ['server/index.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
